name: Sakana Marlin
reason: System is real and verified on the official vendor page (https://sakana.ai/marlin fetched this session): up to 8 hours of continuous autonomous hypothesis->exploration->verification research, explicit AB-MCTS (NeurIPS 2025) and AI Scientist (Nature) lineage, paid tiers with immediate access. But Sakana scopes it exclusively to business/strategy research: 'Virtual CSO', use cases 'strategic planning, market and competitor analysis, tech trend evaluations, and regulatory shifts', for 'corporations, organizations, sole proprietors', 'not intended for general consumer use'. Unlike the OpenAI Deep Research precedent (domain-general, science-usable), Marlin's own positioning places it on the business side of the index's multi-step-scientific-work boundary; the AI-Scientist lineage is technology provenance, not a science use case. Launch date 2026-06-15 remains press-derived and UNVERIFIED on sakana.ai (product page and homepage show no date; https://sakana.ai/news returns 404).
reconsider_when: Sakana documents scientific-research use of Marlin (science-domain examples, scientific benchmark results, or a science-facing mode) on official pages, or the index maintainer explicitly extends the general-deep-research precedent to cover domain-scoped commercial business-research agents.

name: EviGraph
reason: arXiv abs page fetched and matches: 'EviGraph: Evidence-Guided Autonomous Research Agents', arXiv:2608.04738, v1 2026-08-05 / v2 2026-08-06, not withdrawn, cs.AI, 23 pages 2 figures. Autonomous research framework representing the research process as a typed evidence graph (Problem, Gap, Hypothesis, Experiment, Finding, Claim), validating evidence chains and regenerating weak components before manuscript generation; reports +40.19% claim-support over strongest baseline and 87.73% experimental-data consistency.
